overall_reality_verdict.label: MATERIAL_SIMULATOR_AFFINITY_AND_REALITY_CALIBRATION_GAPS_CURRENT_MODEL_COMPARISONS_SHOULD_PAUSE
overall_reality_verdict.meaning: The current W0-W4 family remains useful as an engineering/adversarial test rig, but a win inside it cannot currently support reality-oriented feature or architecture advancement beyond mechanism recovery. Preserve and reclassify the worlds; do not destroy them. Build a separate reality-calibrated family before resuming reality-oriented model competition.

simulator_candidate_affinity_map.truth_side: W0 uses PL-like sequential sampling from latent/context utility with no line effect
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.candidate_side: C0 and C1 use the same PL ordered-top3 generator
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.interpretation: Valid null/control and feature-vs-architecture ablation; not evidence that PL is the real race generator.

simulator_candidate_affinity_map.truth_side: W1 adds symmetric 0.16 times same-line mean latent_skill plus fixed line-position and line-size bonuses
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.candidate_side: Frozen C1 uses a line-position basis through PL but its frozen line_mean_coef and size_coef are zero

simulator_candidate_affinity_map.truth_side: W1 shared-state coefficient is exactly 0.16 on arithmetic mean latent_skill including the target
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.candidate_side: C1_PEER_LOO_MEAN_PROSPECTIVE adds exactly 0.16 times arithmetic mean observable score of same-line peers excluding the target
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.interpretation: The candidate does not access latent_skill or truth, so this is not data leakage. However the hypothesis and coefficient are generator-informed, and observable peer scores are mechanically correlated with the exact hidden line-mean construct. Prospective new seeds protect against seed overfitting, not against world-specification affinity.

simulator_candidate_affinity_map.truth_side: W2 rank-2/rank-3 logits explicitly use same-line, follower and ordered-chain predicates
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.candidate_side: N1 explicitly uses the same predicate family with different frozen coefficients
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.interpretation: W2 is useful as a recoverability test for N1-like conditional structure, not as reality evidence for N1.

simulator_candidate_affinity_map.truth_side: Synthetic observable score is latent_skill plus iid Gaussian noise sd 0.55
simulator_candidate_affinity_map.candidate_side: C0/C1/N1 and PEER all consume this score as the dominant rider-strength observable

critical_findings.finding: Current worlds intentionally encode candidate-adjacent mechanisms, especially W1-to-PEER and W2-to-N1. They are valid engineering/recovery fixtures but insufficient to decide real-keirin feature or architecture value.
critical_findings.action: Pause reality-oriented model competition/feature advancement and split Engineering/Adversarial worlds from a new Reality-Calibrated family.

critical_findings.finding: Repository schema correctly requires mutable line source, observation type, timestamp and provenance, but Stage-0 explicitly leaves exact timestamped LEGSHOW transport and historical point-in-time proof unresolved.
critical_findings.action: No real line-dependent training/validation until exact decision-available source transport is independently proven.

major_findings.finding: observed_score = latent_skill + iid Gaussian noise is not a justified model of official keirin competition score. Official score is a rolling historical performance statistic and official program documents assign competition points by race/placing.

Real keirin clearly has lines and role-dependent cooperation, but official material supports directional/role-specific interactions, not a symmetric arithmetic mean latent-ability uplift applied equally to every line member. The 0.16 coefficient has no established real meaning.

generate_race randomly assigns line membership first and then samples style conditional on line position. Real line formation is related to rider style, locality/relationships and race context, so this generator direction is an artificial scenario prior.

The implementation defaults to STANDARD_FI_FII_7 and labels 9 riders SPECIAL_9. Current Japanese keirin contains multiple grades, 7- and 9-rider programs, and both original and international fixed-pacer regimes. Current code is a constrained engineering regime, not a general Japanese-keirin generator.
Each generated race creates new independent synthetic riders; no stable rider identity, longitudinal form, injuries, fatigue, series-stage state or opponent-history process exists.

minor_findings.finding: generate_race samples only 333, 400 and 500m, while official Japanese tracks include 335m. The schema knows broader geometry, but current generator omits it.
PRE schema includes home-straight length and cant, but current Race/pre_view exposes only bank length and wind speed among these context fields.

race-band, within-band class, line-shape, style-by-position, tactical-count, wind and effect-size weights are hard-coded scenario priors and are already correctly listed by CURRENT_STATE_KEIRIN as unproven realism parameters.

what_is_actually_valid: The PRE/truth firewall works mechanically in the inspected Synthetic paths: latent_skill is withheld from pre_view and the PEER candidate source boundary blocks latent/truth calls.
The ordered-top3 probability generators are useful engineering objects and probability-mass/mechanical invariants are meaningful.
C0 is valid as an explicit PL structural null/control and as a feature-vs-architecture ablation baseline; it should not be removed merely because PL is not a complete reality model.
W0-W4 are useful engineering/adversarial worlds for code correctness, recoverability, failure behavior and anti-overconfidence stress.
W2 can test whether an N1-like architecture can recover an N1-like conditional mechanism; it cannot establish that mechanism in real keirin.
The prospective PEER result establishes recovery of a generator-aligned peer observable signal on new W1 Synthetic fixtures under the fixed protocol; it does not establish real-keirin value.
what_is_not_valid: same-line arithmetic mean latent ability is the real shared line state
symmetric shared line benefit is real
PEER is better than C1/N1 in real keirin
W2 N1 advantage is real-keirin architecture evidence
observed_score latent-plus-Gaussian is a model of official competition score
hard-coded race-band/class/line/style frequencies match Japanese keirin
results from STANDARD_FI_FII_7 generalize across GIII/GII/GI, 9-rider, Girls or international fixed-pacer regimes
unrealistic_or_unproven_conditions: Within-band S1/S2 and A1/A2 prior weights are uncalibrated
Seven-rider line shapes are limited to 3-2-2, 3-3-1 and 2-2-2-1 engineering motifs
Line membership is random rather than endogenous to locality, rider relationships, style and race context
Style is sampled conditional on already-assigned synthetic line position
Official competition score is represented as latent ability plus iid Gaussian measurement noise
W1 symmetric line arithmetic-mean uplift and coefficient 0.16 are uncalibrated
W2 exact same/follower/chain truth form is candidate-adjacent and uncalibrated
335m bank support is omitted from current generator
No race-grade, qualifying/semifinal/final stage, persistent rider, injury, absence/return or series-fatigue state is modeled

real_input_risks: Historical score/win/quinella/trio/S/H/B/maneuver statistics must be historical point-in-time snapshots; current profile values cannot be backfilled into older races.
Line data is mutable and must distinguish PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE from LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE; post-race reconstructed line is prohibited.
Line snapshot must be at or before decision cutoff and withdrawals/active riders must be reconciled.
Weather/wind observations require timestamp <= decision cutoff; venue geometry may be stable master data only with source/version provenance.
Race regime must be sourced from the actual program/rule identity because male races can also use international fixed-pacer rules.

missing_reality_factors_mapped_to_code.code_gap: _base_utility has only a coarse <=333 style bonus and wind penalty; no home-straight or cant interaction

official_reality_findings: Current official KEIRIN material confirms multiple grades GP/GI/GII/GIII/FI/FII and class separation.
2026 official programs include many 7-rider FI/FII A-class races and also GIII program variants with 7 or 9 riders; therefore seven-rider racing is real but not a universal keirin regime.
Official guidance describes line formation, self-powered leaders, chasing riders, bante support, blocking, switching and competition for position; line is real and role-asymmetric/dynamic.
Official rider introduction is a pre-start information point where riders display line formation; exact machine-readable source/timestamp transport remains unresolved in the repository.
Official race cards describe competition score as based on recent four-month performance and define win/2-place/3-place rates, S/H/B and finishing-technique counts as historical statistics.

Official 2026 program documents assign competition points by race/placing, reinforcing that official score is an endogenous historical result statistic rather than direct latent ability plus independent noise.
Official materials document 333/335/400/500m tracks and meaningful bank/wind effects.
Official 2026 material confirms men's KEIRIN ADVANCE uses international fixed-pacer rules, so male does not imply standard-line regime.

top_5_foundation_fixes.action: Freeze W0-W4 semantics as ENGINEERING_ADVERSARIAL_SYNTHETIC_WORLDS and prohibit reality-oriented winner claims from them. Design a separate REALITY_CALIBRATED_WORLD_FAMILY with explicit provenance classes for every calibrated parameter.

Do not model official competition score as latent+iid Gaussian in the reality family. Represent it as an observed historical statistic with point-in-time semantics, or calibrate a separate latent-to-observable process from admissible historical PRE/outcome-aware calibration data without consuming protected validation.

Reality-family line formation must depend on admissible structural factors such as rider role/style, locality/relationships and race context, and must support expected-line versus leg-show-observed snapshots with exact decision-time provenance.
Explicitly model or scope FI/FII/GIII/GII/GI/GP, 7/9 riders, S/A/L classes, original versus international rules, and race stage. Every model/world must declare applicable and excluded regimes.

For reality-oriented worlds, do not transfer truth coefficients/functions directly into candidate specifications. Calibrate truth-side ranges from official/admissible evidence or prespecified broad uncertainty ranges, include role-asymmetric line dynamics and bank geometry, and require performance across mechanism-mismatched worlds before any reality-oriented candidate advancement.

supported_parts: 0.16 truth/candidate overlap is a serious simulator-affinity concern for reality interpretation
latent-plus-Gaussian score is not a justified real competition-score model
W1 symmetric line mean is not established as real line physics/tactics
line and historical aggregate point-in-time availability require strict audit
missing longitudinal, dynamic and regime factors are material
overstated_or_incorrect_parts: Calling 0.16 overlap data leakage is incorrect; no truth information crosses the inspected PRE firewall
Claiming GI through GIII are all nine-rider is inconsistent with current official 2026 GIII program variants
Recommending removal of PL C0 is not supported; repository explicitly uses C0 as a structural null/control, which remains scientifically useful
Actual post-race line leakage was not found in the Synthetic code; the unresolved problem is future real source/timestamp transport
The current repository already labels Synthetic worlds as non-real validation and already records many realism parameters as unproven

condition_for_further_model_research: Only after the Engineering/Adversarial versus Reality-Calibrated world separation is formally specified. Existing W0-W4 may continue for mechanical/adversarial questions that cannot be misread as reality evidence. Reality-oriented candidate competition must wait for a separately governed reality-calibrated world family and independent review.
